what: The button rolls on the x axis like a cube to show its side — when the pointer enters the top half of the button it goes to −90° (top face comes down), the bottom half goes to 90° (bottom face comes up), in .6s expo.out, and on release it rolls back to 0° in .8s expo.inOut leaving the entered side face. The front face is a filled button, the side face is an outlined button with the same text

options.look: If chip, the front face is a chip in the face color and the side is a border in the face color (Brand field tags · player buttons)

note: Not rolled on touch devices (the original also stops when isMobile). Front text reads as is and the two side faces are aria-hidden

from.where: shared.js .sd-btn (Contact · Close · player controls · category tags — original button block: only when data-animate, --height depth, rotateX ±90 .6s expo.out / 0 .8s expo.inOut)

index.html .aq-flip (contact button) — always flips upward only (front face axis at bottom edge 90° · back −90°→0), and both entering and leaving remap a straight .6s timeline with expo.out (in: .6; out: .6; out-ease: close to expo.out)
